summary: Iter-34: GridFS→Timeweb S3 migration verification. 8/8 backend tests pass + frontend render verified. DB is clean (0 /api/files refs across users.photos, messages.media_url, receipt_submissions.receipt_data_url, refund_requests.receipt_data_url). All non-external user photos (90+) match https://s3.twcstorage.ru/<bucket>/lovreski/<kind>/<file> and return HTTP 200 image. New uploads via POST /api/profile/photo and POST /api/chat/media produce direct S3 URLs (NOT /api/files/...). sign_file_url correctly leaves non-/api/files URLs untouched (no ?exp/?sig appended). Cron storage cleanup acks 2xx with WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, latest cleanup-log run shows s3_files count preserved (no referenced files deleted). Chat UI renders image message directly from s3.twcstorage.ru URL. Admin /api/admin/storage shows stores.s3.configured=true, 80 files / 29MB. /api/health=200. Bug report verified RESOLVED.
critical_code_review_comments: storage.py: _public_base() correctly prefers S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL; keys follow lovreski/<kind>/<uuid>.<ext>. Good.
server.py:storage_put returns direct public_url when S3 configured (line 479); DB stores direct URL. Correct.
routers/cron.py:collect_referenced_file_ids returns (object_ids, s3_keys) and S3 orphan loop skips docs whose s3_key is referenced via direct S3 URL (line 105). Correct cleanup safety.
sign_file_url (server.py:106) uses regex /api/files/<24hex>; direct S3 URLs don't match → returned unchanged. Chat message fetch confirms direct S3 URL is NOT mangled.
scripts/rewrite_s3_urls.py is idempotent (regex-anchored match on /api/files/<hex24>) and normalizes public_url host to S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL. Safe to re-run.
Minor: routers/files.py get_file still exists for residual /api/files/<id> refs — kept as redirect-only safety net. OK as graceful fallback; could be removed once confident 0 refs for a quarter.

rca of the issue: Original bug: profile photos stored as /api/files/<gridfs_id> after GridFS→S3 migration, requiring extra API hop. Root cause: storage_put returned /api/files/<id> for S3 uploads too, and existing DB rows kept legacy GridFS URLs. Mitigation (verified applied): (1) storage_put now returns direct public S3 URL for S3 backend; (2) rewrite_s3_urls.py maps s3_files._id→public_url and rewrites users.photos/messages.media_url/receipt_submissions.receipt_data_url/refund_requests.receipt_data_url; (3) cron orphan purge recognises direct S3 URLs via lovreski/ key regex and skips those docs. All verified end-to-end.
